Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and reports suggest the iPhone Pro models will receive a brand-new design. New leaks have reportedly revealed specific specifications for larger screen sizes.

The iPhone Pro will feature larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays next year

In 2017, on the 10th anniversary of the iPhone, Apple prepared a very special model: the iPhone X.

There are reports that the company is preparing a similar unique product for next year's 20th anniversary.

According to reports, next year's iPhone Pro models will adopt a borderless display with curved corners, wrapping around to the edges of the body.

The Dynamic Island cutout may be reduced or even eliminated, achieving a seamless all-glass appearance.

According to the latest post by tipster Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new screen sizes. He said the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches, up from the current 6.3 inches
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches, up from the current 6.9 inches

He added that both devices will have larger bodies, but will maintain the aspect ratio of the current models. Therefore, the larger screens are not simply due to narrower bezels.

The last time Apple increased the size of the Pro models was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max went from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although the size increase next year sounds smaller, combined with the four-corner curved design, the overall look should be even more distinctly different.

What do you think of the rumored design for the next-generation iPhone Pro models? Feel free to leave a comment and let us know.
